A1.source: entry/6048651/event/4/picks + bootstrap + element-summary (GW1 price) + transfers (element_in_cost) + sell-on rule 0.5
A1.note: purchase/selling prices derived from public data; exact for an initial-squad player or an in-season buy

A2.source: picks.entry_history.bank + entry/history (transfers, chips used) + bootstrap.chips + game_settings
A2.note: free-transfer count is not in any public endpoint; derived with the 1/GW roll rule. Chips = bootstrap chip windows minus history.chips

A3.note: FPL now publishes its own price-change progress and 3-night projection; LiveFPL /prices re-renders the same numbers

A4.source: livefpl.us top10k.json (+ locals bands, + FPL selected_by_percent, + bootstrap transfer flow)
A4.note: Decided 5 Sep 2026: cohort EO for the coming GW cannot exist before the deadline (LiveFPL tracks managers only after it — founder AMA), so GW4 actuals are the BASELINE and eo_top10k_projected is the transfer-flow [PROJECTED] value for the captaincy tie-break; the post-deadline actual scores the projection. Not a gate question.

A5.note: bands available: Top100…3M-6M, Top 1M, Elite, Overall. User band = 1M-1.5M. locals_5.json for the coming GW appears only after its deadline.

A7.note: pair-level flow (who → who) is only on livefpl.net /prices Trends tab (browser only)

A8.note: Safety Score and Template Rating are computed client-side on livefpl.net/<team-id>; no JSON endpoint found. Browser step only. locals_N band means allow a rough Safety-Score interpolation (see live-rank.md).

A9.note: lags live during a GW — see live-rank.md

A11.note: live top-3 BPS projection is a LIVE-cadence job; games.json idx 11 carries LiveFPL's provisional bonus during matches
